'''Sola''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Communications officer/Legends|communication officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3639 BBY]] she was stationed on the [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] [[Outrider (Thranta-class corvette)|''Outrider'']] that was assigned by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] to investigate [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] military activity in the [[Vyron system/Legends|Vyron system]]. Upon jumping out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]], the crew witnesses the end of the [[Annexation of the Vyron system|battle]] involving the Hutt Cartel forces and reported the situation to Saresh. Captain [[Hardin (captain)|Hardin]] then took the corvette to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where a strike team shuttled down to the surface to discuss the matter with Cartel leader [[Karagga]]. The confrontation ended in violence and Karagga was killed, leaving the position of the [[Supreme Mogul]] vacant.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Comm officer Sola appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the introductory cutscene for the "Karagga's Palace" operation on Republic side.<ref name="SWTOR" />
